name: Nakamura Mayuka
source:
She is voluptuous and plump but still maintains a moderately toned body. Her sexual appetite is very strong, and she is divorced.

She enjoys cooking and sports. She goes to the gym three times a week. She has a slight "S" side to her, but is motherly and patient.
